risks.title: Dépendance à un nombre limité de grands vendeurs de véhicules
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in risk factors (Item 1A). Strong language used (substantial portion, material adverse effect). Recurring risk with direct impact on revenues and financial position. No single customer exceeds 10% but limited sellers collectively represent substantial portion of revenues. Citation: "In fiscal 2025, we opened one new operational facility in the U.K., two new operational". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company depends heavily on a small number of major vehicle sellers. Loss of one or more major sellers could materially harm financial results and growth rates. Inability to increase vehicle supply sources could adversely affect growth.
risks.title_en: Dependence on limited number of major vehicle sellers

risks.title: Risques liés à l'expansion internationale et aux acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Detailed across multiple sections (Item 1A). Strong language (substantial risks and uncertainties, adverse effect). International expansion is key strategy but complex with integration and profitability risks. Citation: "Our operations and acquisitions in the U.S. and certain foreign areas expose us to political". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: International expansion and acquisitions carry significant risks including integration failures, unforeseen costs, and inability to realize expected synergies, which could negatively impact financial results.
risks.title_en: Risks related to international expansion and acquisitions

risks.title: Risques de cybersécurité et de fraude de paiement
risks.score_rationale: Described in detail in dedicated section (Item 1A). Strong language (compromise or breach, significant legal and financial exposure). Online transaction security is critical to trust and operations. Citation: "Risks Related to Regulatory Compliance and Legal Matters Our business activities and public policy interests". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Company faces exposure to online transaction security risks and credit card fraud. Data breach or fraud could result in significant financial losses and reputational harm.

risks.title: Inability to maintain storage facility capacity
risks.score_rationale: Explained in specific section (Item 1A). Language indicates potential impact (adversely affect relationships, material adverse effect). Storage capacity essential for seller relationships. Citation: "Our failure to manage any of these risks successfully could harm our international operations and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Insufficient storage facility capacity, particularly after climate events, can harm seller relationships and impact operations. Recent hurricane response (Hurricanes Helene and Milton in fall 2024) required significant mobilization.

risks.title: Failure to implement online auction model in new markets
risks.score_rationale: Presented as specific technology-related risk (Item 1A). Cautious language (cannot predict whether synergies will be realized). Inability to replicate past success is material concern. Citation: "Our failure to manage any of these risks successfully could harm our international operations and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Success of online auction model is not guaranteed in new markets. Inability to replicate U.S. and U.K. synergies in new geographies could limit growth potential.

risks.title: Risques d'opérations internationales et de conformité réglementaire
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in international expansion section (Item 1A). Multiple risk areas mentioned (complex foreign and U.S. laws, tariffs, trade barriers). Operations span 11 countries with varying regulations. Citation: "Our failure to manage any of these risks successfully could harm our international operations and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Operating internationally exposes company to complex regulations, trade barriers, and geopolitical risks that could negatively impact operations and profitability.
risks.title_en: International operations and regulatory compliance risks

risks.title: Dependence on transportation subcontractors
risks.score_rationale: Described in dedicated section (Item 1A). Language indicates potential impact (could harm reputation and brand, material adverse effect). Logistics is key operational component. Citation: "Our operations and acquisitions in the U.S. and certain foreign areas expose us to political". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reliance on third-party transportation contractors creates risks of delays, cost increases (fuel prices), and reputational damage if logistics issues occur.

company_description: Copart, Inc. provides online auctions and vehicle remarketing services in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, Spain, Finland, Oman, the Republic of Ireland, and Bahrain. It offers a range of services to process and sell vehicles over the internet through its virtual bidding third generation internet auction-style sales technology. The company's services include online seller access, salvage estimation, estimating, end-of-life vehicle processing, transportation, vehicle inspection stations, on-demand reporting, title processing and express, loan payoff, flexible vehicle processing programs, buy it now, sales process, and dealer services. Its services also comprise services to sell vehicles through BluCar, CashForCars.com, CashForCars.ca, CashForCars.de, CashForCars.co.uk, and Cash-for-cars.ie; Copart Recycling service, which allows the public to purchase parts from salvaged and end-of-life vehicles; and copart 360, a proprietary technology that captures clear 360-degree views of interiors and exteriors of cars, trucks, and vans.
